candidate_reports.remark: NWS employee reports a large snapped tree blocking the right lane of eastbound SR-878 near Dadeland Mall.
Lightning struck a transformer_ causing downed powerlines and a small fire along the metal fence line.
National Wildfire Coordinating Group reports that the Bluegill fire has grown to a size of 750 acres and 0% containment.
Lightning struck palm tree causing fire to spread to a gazebo. Location estimated by radar.
A video passed along by the broadcast media shows metal roofing from a carport failing and falling apart due to strong wind gusts from a thunderstorm moving through the area.
